name: Story: the evening drive to SARO
notes: STORY-DRIVE-20261112 (Tom 12 Nov: Story still begins in the car on the way to SARO). Started first by the evening act (acts.json). A new Story night begins in the player's own station wagon on the highway at the south end of Caliche, heading north (STORY-DRIVE-OWN-CAR-20261113: FS47StoryDirector::BeginDrive, FS47StoryDrive, the old Story's drive and car), on Freeform's own world. The wagon's radio is 1420's local evening host: I01_DRIVE voiced from its takes with the line as a subtitle (S47StoryScene), over Tom's Intro Drive and then the old bed; the radio key turns it off and on. Arrival parks the wagon at SARO; SARO 07 waits on its pad. Arrival is the player on foot in SARO's area (parked on the pad, or got out and walked): then evening_handover starts, which commits I11_SARO_ARRIVAL and lets D01 ring at OPS. The optional diner stop is evening_diner. Without a drive (-S47StoryAtSaro, or the trip could not start) the in_truck wait is left out after 30 s and the night goes on at SARO as before.

beats.text: Drive north through Caliche to SARO for the evening shift. Supper at the Mesa Diner on the way is optional.
